items.exampleEn: The report showed a deficiency in our safety rules.
items.exampleZh: 報告顯示我們的安全規定有不足之處。

items.exampleEn: The first night of the show was disastrous; nothing went right.
items.exampleZh: 表演首夜糟透了，沒有一件事順利。

items.exampleEn: Taichung is a prosperous city with many businesses.
items.exampleZh: 台中是一座有許多企業的繁榮城市。

items.exampleEn: Spring is a transitional season between winter and summer.
items.exampleZh: 春天是冬夏之間的過渡季節。

items.exampleEn: For many buyers, price outweighs everything else.
items.exampleZh: 對很多買家來說，價格比其他一切都重要。

items.exampleEn: Please fasten your seat belt; we are flying through some turbulence.
items.exampleZh: 請繫好安全帶，我們正通過一些亂流。

items.exampleEn: The dog made a threatening sound.
items.exampleZh: 那隻狗發出帶有威脅的聲音。
items.glossZh: 有威脅的；（天氣）要變壞的

items.sentenceEn: The flight was smooth except for a little turbulence over the sea.
items.sentenceZh: 除了在海上遇到一點亂流，這趟飛行很平穩。

items.audioEn: The new manager's first year was disastrous, so the company asked him to leave.
items.audioZh: 新經理的第一年表現極糟，所以公司請他離開。
items.questionZh: 公司為什麼請新經理離開？
options: He was new to the company
He wanted more money from the company
His first year went very badly
He asked to leave the company

items.sentenceEn: For me, the good points of this job outweigh the bad ones.
items.sentenceZh: 對我來說，這份工作的優點多過缺點。

items.sentenceEn: The dog made a threatening noise when we walked past.
items.sentenceZh: 我們走過去時，那隻狗發出威脅的叫聲。

items.stemEn: After ten good years, the town is now rich and ____.
items.stemZh: 經過十年好光景，這個小鎮現在富裕又繁榮。

items.stemEn: The main ____ of this team is its lack of experience.
items.stemZh: 這支隊伍的主要缺陷是缺乏經驗。

items.passageEn: Ten years ago, our company had a disastrous year. Sales fell, and numerous workers left. It was a time of turbulence for everyone. The new boss said the company had one big deficiency: it did not listen to its customers. During a long transitional period, she changed many things. Some changes looked threatening to a few workers, but the benefits outweighed the problems. Today, the company is prosperous again.
items.passageZh: 十年前，我們公司經歷了糟透的一年。業績下滑，很多員工離職。那對每個人來說都是一段動盪的時期。新老闆說公司有一個很大的缺陷：不聽顧客的意見。在一段漫長的過渡時期中，她改變了很多事。有些改變讓部分員工覺得受到威脅，但好處超過了問題。現在，公司又興旺起來了。

questions.questionZh: 新老闆認為公司最大的缺陷是什麼？

items.promptZh: 這個計畫的好處遠大於風險。
referenceEn: The benefits of this plan far outweigh the risks.
The plan's benefits outweigh its risks.
rubricZh: outweigh 表示「比⋯更重要、超過」，A outweigh B＝A 比 B 重要
主詞是複數 benefits，動詞用 outweigh（不加 s）
「遠大於」可加 far、greatly 等加強語氣

items.promptZh: 公司正處於一段過渡時期，很多事情還沒決定。
referenceEn: The company is in a transitional period, and many decisions have not been made yet.
The company is going through a transitional period, and many things have not been decided.
rubricZh: 用 transitional 表示「過渡的」（例如 a transitional period、a transitional stage 等）
「還沒決定」可寫，例如 have not been decided、decisions have not been made 等
